title: Chapter 86
content:
Chapter 86

Patriarch Jones, who finally breathed a sigh of relief, saw that after the group of bowmen outside had retreated, some people actually pushed some larger and more strange-looking siege machines up.

He couldn't help but feel even more apprehensive. At first glance, he knew that those things with larger size must be more powerful than those arrow rains. How could he not let the frightened mind that he just passed by was shocked and horrified!

He couldn't help but feel a burst of powerlessness and despair in his heart. Usually, his strong strength could not give him a sense of security at this time.

He had given up his resistance completely, and he no longer dared to have any other thoughts. He couldn't help but hurriedly ran down the city wall, opened the gate, and quickly ran to the enemy army step by step. White cloth in his arms.

Flying the white cloth over his head, Jones kept making gestures with his hands to show that he was not hostile, hoping that the opposing army would stop and accept his surrender.

Cao Cao looked at the person in front of him. He recognized him. He was just above the city wall. His strength and performance were the strongest. He was able to open a defensive circle of more than 20 meters. powerful.

A person with such a powerful strength should be the leader of the opposite tribe among the barbarians who are absolutely ruled by the law of the jungle.

Look at him holding a white cloth on his head, a sign of formal surrender and surrender in barbaric customs. It seems that he should have been blinded by the attack he had just made, so he completely gave up his resistance and planned to surrender!

It's good, I don't bother to waste the siege materials I have prepared. These materials want to be transported here from Luoyang in the rear, but it takes a lot of manpower and material resources, so I feel a little distressed for such a plain loss.

He waved his hand and signaled to the messenger beside him to stop the attacking movement of the people in front, and at the same time ordered the army in front to separate a path and let the leader get in front of him.

But in just a short while, the leader was inspected anywhere on his body, and the soldiers also saw his previous behavior, and were very afraid that he would suddenly violent when he met Cao Cao, and he had bad intentions.

At that time, Cao Cao, who is not surrounded by powerful guards, is not at stake. If his life is in the hands of the person in front of him, it will not be fun.

The commander-in-chief of a large army was captured. According to the military law of the Great Imperial Kingdom, all the guards of the commander-in-chief were executed. And the three armies will lose their morale because of the loss of the commander-in-chief.

How can this not make these guards feel careful and cautious! Therefore, they searched Jones over and over again, even as if there was a sharp weapon hidden in his hair.

I almost cut him open to see if there was anything, bad stuff XZ in it? Such a rigorous search is undoubtedly an insult and distrust of a person.

Even Patriarch Jones, who was already very humble and sincerely wanted to surrender, felt a little annoyed. But thinking of the rain of arrows just now, and the existence of a stronger siege machine that has not yet exerted its power.

He couldn't help but swallowed the breath in his heart deeply, but he cooperated and let the guards search him. Although the search was complicated, it only took him more than ten minutes to operate.

Soon Jones went through any inspection, and any weapons and objects that could be used to kill people were taken down by the guards, collected in one place, and returned to Jones when he returned.

After some inspection, Jones came to fifty meters away from the high platform where Cao Cao was standing under the leadership of the guards. This is a safe distance, even if the previous strength wanted to cross the fifty meters, run up the high platform, and carry out assassination and hostage operations.

It also took him more than ten seconds, and during this time, it was enough for the surrounding troops to react and protect the commander to evacuate, and the assassin in front of him was encircling and suppressing.

Not to mention that long before Cao Cao decided to approach him, he secretly gathered a group of fierce generals to guard him. Although these fierce generals do not have the extraordinary power of fighting spirit, their own strength is not weaker than those of the second-order existence.

Just like Taishi Ci, Xu Chu, Dian Wei and others, this company of more than ten fierce generals guarded around him, plus the secretly hidden bowmen around him were always aiming, Cao Cao was relatively assured of his own safety.

Jones walked all the way under the guidance of the guards. He was stopped fifty meters away from Cao Cao and stopped. It seemed that he planned to communicate with him here.

Jones looked at the surrounding guards from left to right, and used his spiritual sense to check the front. The guards around the leader, after this exploration, surprised him.

The person in front of the commander-in-chief, there is not a single person with fighting spirit around, they are all ordinary people, at most they are relatively powerful ordinary people.

This is really incredible, there is an army of 50,000 people, and there is no one with extraordinary power among them.

At such a moment, a sense of contempt rose in Jones' heart. This group of country bumpkins without strong people dared to invade your Uncle Jones's territory.

This is what I thought in my heart, and there was a proud expression on his face. The original humility had disappeared, and his head glanced around, and finally stopped on the face of Cao Cao in front of him.

His eyes looked at him with a look of scrutiny, but he was surprised to find that the general in front of him was looking at him with an extremely indifferent gaze.

That look, like looking at a dead man, made Jones feel humiliated. This was originally the look he used to look at the lowly people of his tribe.

Now, an ant who is many times weaker than himself is staring at him unscrupulously, as if he is watching how humble and begging for mercy.

Just as he was about to launch an attack, he taught the ants who didn't know his dignity well, and let him understand what kind of humility he should maintain in the face of the strong.

But suddenly felt a creepy feeling, cheered up, and used his keen intuition far beyond ordinary people to carefully explore the surroundings.

However, he found that the few people around the leader made him feel a sense of threat. And there seems to be some places that I can't see, and there is a cold feeling.

That gloomy feeling was like being targeted by countless arrows just above the city wall. Immediately, his mind was clear, and the originally cloudy brain became clear.

After regaining his sober mind, he immediately understood the current situation. He was no longer the majestic Jones patriarch, but a defeated person who was now defeated and brought to prisoner status!

The arrogant and presumptuous behavior of his just now undoubtedly caused a bad impression on the winner in front of him.

Even if the winner in front of him is an ordinary person without a trace of extraordinary power, he can now decide his own life and the survival of his tribe. His current actions are undoubtedly pushing his own form to a disadvantageous position.

Thinking of this, I couldn't help feeling cold, and I quickly fell to my knees, constantly slamming my head on the ground, blood flowing out, but in the end, I kept saying words like asking for forgiveness, and my demeanor became humble again.
